units.rawText: I've played this scene over and over, and it always fills me with so much passion. But that day, I learned that while a mask may cover tears, it cannot hide one's pain. Even now, my neural cloud can't process the fact that she's no longer here with us.

units.rawText: But that's the reason... the reason I wear this bracelet. Not to seek revenge, not to stand in her stead, but to carry her will and walk the trail she blazed.
